title: Is jazz an art form: America's classical music
summary: Sam says jazz is America's classical music and criticizes fusion and radio stations like WRVR.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: One of the, um, things that, uh, seems to be a-a big part of what's happening now, as you know, there's been a question for a long time in terms of jazz being accepted as commercial pop music or an art form or and there's a--many schools of thought on it in terms of is jazz a popular type of music or should it--its artists being looked upon as artists. he question I would like to ask--ask you, uh, first of all do you--do you jazz as an art form or do you view it as-as more as transient pop kind of music--how, how, how do you--do you understand the nature of the question--how do you see jazz. Do you see it as a-a classical type music or classic music--how do you really view jazz?
I think jazz is--is a classical

type of music, because it's a music that you will never, you know, go away, or just be distasteful or disliked. And, uh, to me, um, I've heard jazz music, you know, when I came into the world and I--and I'm still listening to that jazz music in my senior years and it's still going strong and even when I'm gone it will still be going strong. Just like jazz is, is, is America's classical music and uh, and I think people should stop saying jazz is dead and jazz is this and jazz is that. Now, jazz is a music our fathers, our forefathers created in this country and I, uh, and I think it should be in all the institutes all over--all over the country. And it should be taught by the professional people in this country. And, um, noway it's a commercial type music now. And I think--and another thing I'd like to say to you I hear on the radio on some of these stations where, they got these uh, uh, used to be jazz musicians, uh, uh, I'll quote again, 'used-to-be-jazz musicians,' uh, but have changed over to what they call fusion. And that's fine, you know, they can get that--that music, uh, uh, they can give that any name they want to give it, you know, but please don't let us associated with, with the American classical jazz music; because it's not. You know, like uh, you hear a lot of stuff on WRVR, the station WRVR, station, they playing jazz music; they aren't playing jazz music over there.
